description: Document commands exempt from recording an undo entry (REG-07, rule R7 of blueprint §4.4). Every other IDocumentCommand must return UndoIntent.Record for every generated document; the rule test applies all commands to generated documents and fails on any other intent. Each exemption states why undoing it would not be a user-visible data change.

exemptions.justification: Counting an execution is not an edit: it would flood the 20-entry history and is persisted apart in usage.json (§6.4, §6.5).
Moving the panel is placement, not data; undoing it would move the panel under the user's finger (§6.4).
Only for settings whose SettingDescriptor has Undoable = false (presentation and placement); every other setting records an undo entry (§6.3).
Finishing the welcome is a single one-way step; undoing it would reopen the welcome over the imported data (§6.3).
